sandbachFocus: Leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend an impressive run that has seen them win seven of their last eight matches and draw the other. Sandbach sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, and face a struggling Alsager side who are bottom of the division with just 4 points and have lost their last four games.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach, with Stafford having picked up draws in their last two outings. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in what should be an intriguing clash between two in-form sides—Bridgnorth have won five of their last six despite a recent loss, while Eccleshall have recovered from their latest defeat with a strong run. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth on goal difference, entertain Wednesfield Community in a midtable encounter; Casuals showed their title credentials with a recent win. Bilston Town, sitting sixth, travel to Foley Meir in a fixture between two teams with solid recent form, while New Mills host Market Drayton Town—both sides are in the lower half but New Mills have shown resilience despite recent losses. Shawbury United, struggling near the bottom, face an away trip to Barnton, who have been inconsistent; Barnton's recent win may give them momentum. Crewe, second from bottom, host Allscott Heath in a critical fixture where both need points to climb away from danger. Finally, Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a bottom-half battle between two teams desperately seeking wins, while Widnes Town, pointless at the foot of the table, travel to Brereton Social hoping to end their winless streak.
